title: Traffic Noise Meter
subtitle: Real-time traffic noise level measurement and display
desc: Measure and display real-time traffic and environmental noise levels using a sound sensor!
fullDesc: The Traffic Noise Meter project measures ambient noise levels using a sound sensor and displays readings on an LCD.
author: Niktrix

hardwareSpecs.microphoneSensor: Electret Condenser Microphone with LM393 Dual Output
hardwareSpecs.display: 16x2 Character LCD via I2C PCF8574 Backpack
hardwareSpecs.alertIndicators: Tri-color Traffic Noise LEDs (Green < 55dB, Yellow 55-75dB, Red > 75dB)
